name: Morning Digest — daily one-screen summary
description: Computes the previous 24h of docket activity (shipped / blockers / decisions / awaiting-Joseph) anchored to yesterday 08:05 local. Emits markdown / banner / JSON; posts to Telegram via @openclaw/skill-reach-cascade when run with default format. Triggered by LaunchAgent at 08:05 CDT today; eventual home is openclaw cron. Salvages chuck-morning-digest.mjs.

telegramChatId.label: Telegram chat id
telegramChatId.help: Numeric chat id Joseph receives the daily digest on.

anchorHour.label: Anchor hour (0-23)
anchorHour.help: Hour-of-day at which the digest window starts (default 8 = 08:05 if anchorMinute=5).

windowChannelMaxItems.label: Max items per section
windowChannelMaxItems.help: Hard cap per section (shipped / blockers / decisions / awaiting). Default 8.
